text:
maria: Heads-up — CI is flapping on eval-runner integration for sampled generation. Failing test: eval-runner::integration::sampled_generation_test in job 78912. Repro: sometimes the BLEU/ROUGE diffs jump and cause CI to fail even though model artifacts are identical :confused:

sam: I saw the same yesterday. Re-ran locally with the exact model tgz and sometimes pass/fail flips. Suspect RNG/seed handling + sampling params (temp/top_p) interaction.

ajun: Minimal repro config I used: 
```\nsampling:\n  temperature: 0.7\n  top_p: 0.9\n  seed: 42\n  sample: true\n```\nI printed the first 3 tokens across runs and they differ intermittently.

maria: CI logs show the runner claiming it sets seed at start: `set_global_seed(42)` but also calls `torch.randint` in a helper that doesn't use the global RNG — looks suspicious.

sam: Could be we reinstantiate np.random.RandomState somewhere (stateful) or use torch.Generator inconsistently. Also CUDA kernels can be nondet for sampling ops.

ashley: CI job 78912 output snippet: 
```\n[runner] set_global_seed(42)\n[runner] sampling step 1: using torch.multinomial on logits\n[runner] sampled token: 118\n[runner] sampled token: 201\n[runner] sampled token: 5\n```\nNext CI rerun had different tokens with same seed.

maria: Hypothesis: the sampling helper does `torch.multinomial(logits, 1)` and elsewhere we call `torch.multinomial` again but with a new Generator not seeded. Also some code path calls `.cpu()` then uses numpy without carrying seed.

sam: Quick patch idea: centralize RNG usage into eval_runner/rng.py with helpers: `get_torch_generator(seed=None)` and `sample_with_generator(logits, gen)`. Then ensure each eval run builds gen = get_torch_generator(config.seed) and threads use it.

jun: FYI, deterministic flags won't solve sampling nondet on CUDA completely: `torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)` can break ops and isn't supported for `multinomial` on GPU. If we require strict determinism for CI, we could run sampling on CPU (slower) or switch to probability-ranking (argmax) for determinism in tests.

qa-bot: Flaky-test detector note: this test has failed 3/10 in the last week, flakiness score 0.37. Recommend quarantining while we fix.

maria: Agreed to quarantine. Working plan: (1) add temporary flag `force_deterministic_sampling: true` for CI that runs CPU sampling with pinned RNG, (2) refactor RNG helpers, (3) add unit that asserts same token sequence for same seed across 20 runs, (4) open follow-up to explore GPU determinism and document tradeoffs.

sam: I'll take the refactor. Quick patch diff idea: 
```\n# bad\nprobs = F.softmax(logits, dim=-1)\nidx = torch.multinomial(probs, 1)\n\n# good\ngen = get_torch_generator(seed)\nprobs = F.softmax(logits, dim=-1)\nidx = torch.multinomial(probs, 1, generator=gen)\n```\nNote: set generator on all sampling calls and avoid numpy.random anywhere in the hot path unless seeded from generator state.

ashley: For CI we should also pin these envs: `PYTHONHASHSEED=0`, `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` (for easier repros), and lock numpy/pytorch versions in the job container.

maria: I'll add the quarantined test flag and update the CI job template. Sam, add the RNG refactor PR and include a small stress test: run 20 repeats in-process and fail if any mismatch.

sam: Will do. Also adding a short doc blurb in eval-runner/README about why temp/top_p + sampling require careful RNG plumbing.

ashley: After the patch, let's re-enable the test and run the 78912 job 5 times in quick succession in staging. If stable, promote.

ci-bot: Job 78912 marked quarantined by maria at 2024-03-22T11:07:03Z :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks all. leaving notes in the PR about potential perf tradeoff (CPU sampling slow) and that production inference should keep GPU sampling but tests should use deterministic mode or argmax baseline.

sam: one more gotcha — beam search is deterministic given seed only if all randomness (length penalty sampling for diversity, etc.) is disabled. Will add regression test for beams too.

maria: OK closing thread, tracking in GH issue #4123 and onboarding the fix into the model bring-up checklist. :rocket:
